reviews.comment: She is a really good professor. You will become a better writer if you take her class. She cares about her students, is very accessible outside of class, and is accommodating to students. She provides a rubric for every assignment, so you will do well if you follow them.

Professor Weber is fantastic! She is super caring, always willing to answer questions, and was clear on expectations for her assignments. She takes attendance, so be sure to go to class and you'll do just fine. She's a PhD student, so I think she tried to make sure she didn't overload us with busywork while also making the course valuable.
She is so sweet and caring. She does take attendance so go to class. Read the literature assigned and you'll do fine.

Professor Weber was overall really great. The class itself isn't very difficult if you put in the effort, but professor Weber graded everything super fairly and gave lots of feedback. She was always super nice and willing to work with you to make sure your successful. There is a group project, discussion post and an application packet.
